title: In Vitro Bone Marrow–Derived Dendritic Cells Generation for Antigen Presentation Assay
author: Sudhakar Singh
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: C57BL/6 mice (wild-type B6 mice, Jackson Laboratory, strain#
C57BL/6-Tg (TcraTcrb)1100Mjb/J (OT1 TCR transgenic mice, Jackson Laboratory, strain#
CFSE (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Invitrogen, catalog number: C34570 )
Trypan blue 0.4% solution in Dulbecco’s phosphate buffered saline (HIMEDIA, catalog number: TCL
Murine GM-CSF (Thermo Fisher Scientific, PeproTech, catalog number: 315-03-20UG, product format: 5 ng/mL in SFRPMI)
Murine IL4 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, PeproTech, catalog number: 214-14-20UG, product format: 5 ng/mL in SFRPMI)
Mouse CD8 T-Cell Isolation kit (BioLegend, catalog number:
Dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) (Thermo Fisher Scientific, catalog number:

steps.title: Euthanize mouse and harvest bone marrow
steps.instruction: Euthanize a C57BL/6 WT mouse in a CO₂ chamber (or approved alternative), place it supine, cut the skin over the hips, pull the skin toward the footpads, remove tibia and femur by cutting into the pelvis, clean off muscles and fibrous tissue with scissors and forceps, wipe bones with a 70 % ethanol‑saturated Kimwipe, add 10 mL cold FACS buffer to a 100 mm dish, cut both epiphyses off the bones, hold bones with forceps and flush marrow into the buffer using a 2 mL 25‑gauge syringe until bones turn white.

steps.title: Collect marrow cells and perform RBC lysis
steps.instruction: Transfer flushed cells to a 15 mL sterile Falcon tube, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, add 3 mL ice‑cold RBC lysis buffer, resuspend gently by reverse pipetting and incubate on ice 3–4 min; then add 3 mL RPMI, mix, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 3 mL RPMI (repeat lysis if pellet is reddish).

steps.title: Count bone marrow cells
steps.instruction: Determine cell concentration using a hemocytometer (Trypan blue exclusion).

steps.title: Initiate BMDC culture
steps.instruction: Plate 10–15 × 10⁶ bone‑marrow cells in 15 mL RPMI supplemented with 5 ng/mL murine GM‑CSF and 5 ng/mL IL‑4 (final cytokine concentrations), and incubate in a humidified 5 % CO₂, 37 ° C incubator for 2 days.

steps.title: Refresh cytokine medium on day 2
steps.instruction: After 48 h, carefully remove 5 mL of spent medium from each plate and replace with 5 mL fresh RPMI containing 5 ng/mL GM‑CSF and 5 ng/mL IL‑4.

steps.title: Harvest adherent dendritic cells on day 6
steps.instruction: On day 6, discard all non‑adherent (suspended) cells, add 5 mL RPMI to each plate, gently scrape adherent cells with a cell scraper, collect the cell suspension into 15 mL Falcon tubes, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at room temperature, and resuspend the pellet in 3 mL RPMI. Cells are now ready for staining and sorting.

steps.title: Stain and sort CD11c⁺ CD11b⁺ BMDCs
steps.instruction: Aliquot the resuspended cells into three 500 µL portions in 1.5 mL tubes (unstained, CD11b‑only, CD11c‑only). Add anti‑mouse CD11b‑FITC (1:400) to the CD11b‑only tube and anti‑mouse CD11c‑PE‑Cy7 (1:300) to the CD11c‑only tube. To the remaining 15 mL tube (master sample), add anti‑CD11b‑FITC (1:400) and anti‑CD11c‑PE‑Cy7 (1:300). Incubate all tubes on ice in the dark for 45 min. Add 10 mL FACS buffer, wash by centrifugation 300 × g for 5 min at 4 ° C, discard supernatant, resuspend cells in 1 mL RPMI, pass through a 70 µm cell strainer, and keep on ice. Run unstained and FMO controls on the sorter to set voltages, apply the gating strategy, sort CD11c⁺ CD11b⁺ double‑positive cells, and perform a post‑sort purity check.

steps.title: Isolate OT‑1 lymphocytes
steps.instruction: Euthanize an OT‑1 TCR transgenic mouse in a CO₂ chamber, dissect cervical, axillary, mesenteric lymph nodes and spleen, place tissues in a 100 mm Petri dish containing 2 mL cold RPMI, gently crush with the soft end of a 3 mL syringe plunger through a 70 µm cell strainer, add ~8 mL RPMI, transfer to a 15 mL Falcon tube, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 ° C, discard supernatant, perform RBC lysis as described in step 2, spin again 300 × g for 5 min at 4 ° C, discard supernatant, resuspend in 10 mL RPMI, wash (300 × g 5 min), resuspend in 500 µL RPMI, and count cells.

steps.title: Purify CD8⁺ T cells by MACS
steps.instruction: Add the recommended volume of the biotin‑conjugated anti‑CD8 antibody cocktail to the 500 µL cell suspension and incubate as per the manufacturer’s protocol, wash and resuspend in RPMI, add the specified volume of streptavidin‑conjugated magnetic beads, incubate, then isolate CD8⁺ T cells using the magnetic column system. Wash the purified cells once by centrifugation 300 × g for 5 min, resuspend in 2 mL serum‑free media, and count. Yield from one mouse is typically 1–1.5 × 10⁷ cells.

steps.title: CFSE‑label OT‑1 T cells
steps.instruction: Place ~10 × 10⁶ CD8⁺ OT‑1 cells in 500 µL serum‑free RPMI (15 mL Falcon). Prepare a 5 µM CFSE working solution by adding 0.5 µL of 5 mM CFSE stock to 500 µL serum‑free RPMI in a 1.5 mL tube, vortex, then add the working solution dropwise to the cells with gentle mixing. Incubate at room temperature for 10 min in the dark, then add an equal volume of serum to quench unbound dye, wash by centrifugation 300 × g for 5 min, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL RPMI, and keep the labeled cells on ice in the dark.

steps.title: Pulse BMDCs and co‑culture with OT‑1 cells
steps.instruction: Prepare SIINFEKL peptide working stock at 1 mg/mL in RPMI and OVA stock at 200 µg/mL in RPMI. In a 96‑well U‑bottom plate add 2 × 10⁴ BMDCs per well in 100 µL RPMI. Add varying concentrations of peptide (e.g., 1–100 µg) and incubate 45 min, or varying concentrations of OVA (1–5 000 ng) and incubate 2 h. After incubation, wash the cells by centrifugation at 300 × g for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant, resuspend in 100 µL RPMI, and add 2 × 10⁵ CFSE‑labeled OT‑1 cells per well. Incubate the co‑cultures for 72 h at 37 ° C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Stain co‑culture for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Add anti‑mouse CD8α antibody (1:100 dilution) to each well, incubate 30 min at 4 ° C in the dark, wash twice by centrifugation 300 × g for 5 min, resuspend cells in 200 µL FACS buffer, acquire data on a flow cytometer (e.g., BD Accuri C6), and analyze CFSE dilution to assess T‑cell proliferation.
